english.note: Use this colloquial form for a strong prediction or certainty, often before a verb and especially in phrases such as 實唔會.
Use this colloquial adverb when confidently predicting that something will happen or be true.

examples.english: They undoubtedly won't believe you if you put it that way.
examples.jyutping: nei5 gam3 joeng2 gong2 keoi5 sat6 m4 wui5 seon3

examples.english: I will surely win this time.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 gam1 ci3 sat6 wui5 jeng4
